listings.thesis: A real optical/laser AI infrastructure beneficiary, but far from undiscovered; alpha depends on sustained optical scarcity.
listings.catalysts: AI datacom transceivers; lasers; manufacturing leverage.

priorCase.rankRationale: This page rewards undiscovered nodes. The CHIPS+NVIDIA groundbreaking is a positive fundamental but it only deepens COHR's well-covered, $77B, NVIDIA-anointed status - the opposite of latent. Thesis ('far from undiscovered') is reinforced, so hold low.

listings.thesis: selective AI/edge/power exposure; less direct than HBM, advanced packaging and AI networking names.

priorCase.rankRationale: On the AI-node bottleneck lens the June 16 CHIPS LOI quadrupling InP wafer capacity (ahead of schedule, NVIDIA-tied) directly relieves the supply constraint gating 800G/1.6T optics demand booked into 2028 - a genuine fundamental improvement, not flow.

listings.risk: Large recent rerating; execution/capacity build risk

priorCase.rankRationale: Most on-thesis page. The stated risk - 'large recent rerating / capacity build risk' - was materially de-risked: CHIPS LOI funds the InP expansion and NVIDIA groundbreaking validates CPO/optics demand directly at the constraint this lens measures.
